perItemFindings.one_line: Its absence trace incorrectly says `expectation_le_rademacher` is sorry-backed: `Causalean/Stat/Concentration/Rademacher/Symmetrization.lean` re-exports the fully proved FoML theorem (`FoML/Rademacher.lean:1184`), while Causalean also has proved `dudley_entropy_integral_bound`; only the countable-index/outer-continuum bridge remains unsupplied.

verbatim_critique: Re-size the generic empirical-process interface against the proved symmetrization and Dudley primitives. Do not describe `expectation_le_rademacher` as a sorry dependency. It is not a clean direct reuse for the uncountable outer-supremum statement because it requires a countable index, but the plan must determine whether that remaining separability/outer-expectation bridge is bounded build work; retain an external interface only if that exact residual gap is still research-scale.
